propPlay.writeup:
Jordin Canada has cleared 6+ points in 87% of her 45 games this season, and is riding a 3-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 80% over her last 5, averaging 11.2 points on the season (12.6 across her last 5) — the 6+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -590 at Caesars.

Olivia Miles has cleared 13+ points in 86% of her 44 games this season, and is riding a 3-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 80% over her last 5, averaging 18.9 points on the season (18.8 across her last 5) — the 13+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -630 at Fanatics.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -282 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.

Olivia Miles shows an identical profile: 86 percent hit rate across 44 games, 90 percent over the last 10, and 3 straight clears of the 13+ line she is being asked to exceed. What both legs demand is that two players, each with established season-long consistency and matching recent streaks, both clear modest thresholds in the same slate.
